method: Same mechanic-aware heuristic for all versions. Balanced attributes. Native combat and current economy/XP, no potions. Full HP/MP between fights; one gifted level after death/escape, repeat failures improve one gear slot. Initial Floresta/Caverna gear retained, Forest accessory; not set optimized. Stop on final boss victory or 11 deaths already at level100 with six legendary pieces. Records include all fights and skill use. Nature policy is new. Version before replaces game.js with the baseline revision; same other files.
